t: A paid coding platform with an autograder, browser editor, and AI assistant inside the LMS.
steps: Open the CodeGrade site and check the free tier of 50 students.
Ask IT to approve the LTI integration with your LMS.
Review the privacy terms and where data is processed.
Connect CodeGrade to Canvas, Blackboard, Moodle, or Brightspace.
Try the pre-built Introduction to Python curriculum.
Create an assignment and write one test.
Set the AI assistant options and check the logs.
Run a trial submission from a student account.
